intro: Oil and gas pay most of Oman's way, and it is working to grow tourism, fishing and logistics.

chapters.title: Oil and gas
text: Oman produces less oil than its neighbours, and its reserves will not last as long, so it is investing in ports at Duqm and Sohar and in green hydrogen.

chapters.title: Other work
text: Dates, fish, frankincense and tourism to mountains, beaches and forts are important.

keyTerms.meaning: Hydrogen fuel made with renewable energy.
